facts.statement: Coburgosuchus lived during the Late Triassic period.
The genus Coburgosuchus was named after Coburg, Germany, where the type specimens were discovered.
facts.quote: The genus was named for Coburg, Germany, the type locality where specimens have been found dating back to the Late Triassic.

facts.statement: Coburgosuchus is classified as an extinct genus of mystriosuchin phytosaur.
facts.quote: Coburgosuchus is an extinct genus of mystriosuchin phytosaur.

facts.statement: It is debated whether Coburgosuchus is synonymous with other phytosaurs like Nicrosaurus or Phytosaurus.
facts.quote: it may prove to be synonymous with other phytosaurs such as Nicrosaurus or Phytosaurus.

facts.statement: Coburgosuchus lived between 227.3 and 205.7 million years ago during the Norian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Norian to Norian (227.3 to 205.7 million years ago)

facts.statement: Coburgosuchus belongs to the parent group Phytosauria.
Coburgosuchus is classified within the class Reptilia.
